changelog: v0.2.5: Fix speech recognition on Android and desktop with dual-mode operation: when Live Mode is OFF, microphone is push-to-talk (starts on mic tap, auto-finalizes and stops mic when user finishes speaking, keeping mic closed afterwards); when Live Mode is ON, microphone stays continuously open and auto-reopens after AI speaks; fix false-positive anti-echo rejection by ensuring echo filtering is only active while assistant is speaking.
